hints.title: Precedence and Operand Tracking
hints.text: Explore expressions recursively, tracking the current running evaluation total and the previous multiplied operand.

hints.title: Multiplication Precedence Rollback
hints.text: When multiplying, subtract the previous term from the running total and add back previous times current number.

hints.title: Recursive Expression Backtracking
hints.text: Iterate prefix substrings of num. Reject substrings with leading zero. If at start of string, initialize total and prev. Otherwise try operators: for + pass total + val and val; for - pass total - val and -val; for * pass total - prev + prev * val and prev * val.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of digits string num
complexity.notes: Optimal recursive exploration branching on 4 operator choices (+, -, *, join).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating expressions with standard eval on all strings causes immense parsing overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Running total and previous operand tracking computes expression values in-flight.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle operator precedence by tracking the previous added or subtracted term.
